commits.message: beginning to switch facts to list of common misconceptions

ingredients: Use plurals for units where appropriate

Use the new api introduced in the previous commit to
display units in plural form where appropriate.

https://bugzilla.gnome.org/show_bug.cgi?id=783810

Add plural api for unit names

Add translatable plurals of the unit names.
Add a new getter: gr_unit_get_plural().
plurals api causing crash, working on converting between metric and imperial

Add locale setting for temperature conversion

In addition to Fahrenheit and Celsius, added locale to the possible
options for preferred temperature.  If locale is selected, it looks
for a locale and chooses the preferred temperature unit for that
area (generally Fahrenheit in the US and Celsius elsewhere).

https://bugzilla.gnome.org/show_bug.cgi?id=778695

Bug 777324 - Unable to reorder ingredients

Added up and down buttons in the edit page, so you can reorder your
ingredients list without deleting and retyping your ingredient.

Bug 778996 - match chef names when searching

Added a get_chef_fullname function to pull the name of the chef for
the recipe, added that fullname to the list of things the search
function checks against.
